build_unsupervised_model: build an unsupervised fasttext model from random text data with configurable dimension and n-gram settings
build_supervised_model: build a supervised fasttext classification model from labeled text data with configurable hyperparameters
test_supervised_model: test a supervised fasttext model on a data file and verify precision, recall, and example count match expected values
test_model_quantization: quantize a trained supervised fasttext model and verify the quantized model preserves precision and recall within tolerance
test_tokenize_api: test the fasttext tokenize function to verify correct tokenization of text including empty strings, whitespace, and newline handling
